inputs.prompt: Create one coherent image from three references with separate roles. Image1 is the body-pose reference: follow its limb placement, body orientation, camera viewpoint and framing. Image2 is the person reference: preserve this person's identity, facial features, hairstyle, body characteristics, visual style, background and lighting. Image3 is the outfit reference: dress the person in the garments and accessories shown there, preserving their colors, patterns, materials, layering and design details. Change the pose of the person in image2 to the pose in image1 and replace their original outfit with the outfit in image3. Fit the clothes naturally to the posed body, with coherent folds and occlusion. Render the result in the visual style of image2. Do not copy the line drawing, invisible mannequin, display stand, reference background or annotations from the other references. Produce a single finished image of the person, not a reference sheet or collage.
